subject: Priv stack modular handoff + rollforward / rollback plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@acme-bank.com>, security@acme-bank.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Priv stack modular handoff + rollforward / rollback plan

Hi Alice / Acme security team,

As discussed on the call this morning, we are ready to hand off the next iteration of the private deployment modules for your VPC/on‑prem PoC. Attached are the tarball of the Terraform/Helm bundle (priv-stack-modules-v2.tf.tar.gz) and a concise rollback runbook (rollback-runbook.md). High-level notes: 

- What changed: modularized network + service modules, explicit KMS integration hooks, and a shortened bootstrapping path for air‑gapped installs.
- CI gating: changed pipeline to require two green integration tests and a successful kubeconform scan. See PR link in metadata.
- Rollback guarantee: the runbook describes an automated rollforward job with a corresponding manual rollback that should restore the prior state within ~15 minutes for core services.

Asking: security review focused on KMS usage and egress rules (we default to deny, then allow required control plane ranges). Can you confirm if the KMS key policy template here meets Acme's key isolation requirements?

I'll loop in Hannah (security reviewer) and Laura (CI) from our side for quick follow-ups. Proposed timeline:
- 48h security review window
- Patch small issues, then schedule a controlled deploy in the maintenance window Friday 11/13 02:00–05:00 UTC if approved.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555‑0182

Attachments: priv-stack-modules-v2.tf.tar.gz, rollback-runbook.md
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Wu <alice.wu@acme-bank.com>, security@acme-bank.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-07T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Priv stack modular handoff + rollforward / rollback plan

Thanks Mina — quick initial review after skimming the bundle. A few items for Acme/security to confirm: 

1) KMS key policy: the template grants cross‑account usage to the redwood-inference-deploy role. Acme's reqs asked for a 'least privilege' key policy scoped to the operator principal only. Please confirm whether you prefer the operator principal alone or the operator + audit role.

2) Egress rules: I see the modules allow 443 to a set of control‑plane IPs. We should change the default to explicit IP lists pulled from an allowlist variable rather than a CIDR. That will make audits easier.

3) Secrets management: Helm charts include placeholders for Vault; for air‑gapped installs we need to call out a sealed‑secret fallback — I'll add a short snippet to the runbook.

I ran the kubeconform config locally and had two non‑blocking warnings related to PodSecurityPolicy mappings; I'll attach the run output if useful.

I'll prepare a small PR with the key policy and allowlist variable changes and ping the thread.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-08T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Priv stack modular handoff + rollforward / rollback plan

Quick CI update — I triggered the integration pipeline for the modules branch this morning and one job is failing consistently in our infra CI: the post‑deploy smoke test that validates KV cache persistence across restarts. Link: https://ci.redwoodinference.com/job/priv-stack-deploy/2374

Snippet from ci-failure.log (attached):

--- ci-failure.log ---
ERROR: redis-persist-check failed: persisted RDB file not found after restart (node-3)
Trace: kv-cache/persistence.go:112
--- end ---

I'm leaving this open for now; likely cause is the new mount permissions in the statefulset helm template (we tightened fsGroup). I'll push a branch to the infra repo to loosen the mount for that job and re-run.

Laura
Laura Bennett
CI/CD Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Nov 7, 2026 at 11:02 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (see above)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alice Wu <alice.wu@acme-bank.com>, security@acme-bank.com, ops@acme-bank.com
Date: 2026-11-08T13:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Priv stack modular handoff + rollforward / rollback plan

Great — thanks Laura and Hannah. Status update: 

- Hannah: please attach the small PR with the KMS policy and allowlist variable. If Acme confirms operator+audit is acceptable, we'll merge.
- Laura: thanks for the log — I reviewed and the loose mount change is fine for the installer stage only; we will add a followup to harden mounts post‑deploy. Please re-run CI after your branch lands.

I've opened PR #482 with the following: modular network + kms hooks + a new flag `enable_sealedsecret_fallback`. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

Deployment plan (proposed):
1) Merge PR and gate on two green CI runs.
2) During maintenance window (Fri 11/13 02:00–05:00 UTC) run a staged canary against non‑prod VPC (1 zone).
3) If canary passes, deploy to Acme staging (single rack). Smoke test run takes ~12 minutes.
4) If any smoke test fails, follow rollback-runbook.md — the automated rollback job will revert modules to the previous committed tag and run a partial state reconciliation. Manual rollback instructions are included if automation fails.

Alice / Acme ops/security — can you confirm the maintenance window and sign off on the KMS policy plan so we can schedule?

Thanks,
Mina
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alice Wu <alice.wu@acme-bank.com>, security@acme-bank.com, ops@acme-bank.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Priv stack modular handoff + rollforward / rollback plan

Acknowledged and scheduled: per Mina's plan I booked the maintenance window on Acme's calendar for 2026-11-13 02:00–05:00 UTC and set up the deployment runbook in our runbook-runner. Checklist I'm tracking: 
- [x] PR #482 opened
- [x] CI gating configured (2 green runs)
- [ ] KMS policy confirmation from Acme (waiting)
- [ ] Final smoke test plan signoff (Laura to provide exact query/assert list)

I'll coordinate on-call rotation for the night of the deploy and confirm rollback contacts. If Acme security confirms operator+audit key policy we can mark KMS confirmed and proceed.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
